name: Expose the Culprit — "Turn target face-down creature face up" is its own mode, picked and turned there
notes: 2026-11-20. The face-down / face-up marker (_faceMarker) was read after the modes of a modal spell were tagged, so it had no mode: the mode's target pick never reached it and the face-down creature stayed face down. The face block now runs before the tagging, as the phasing one does. Expose the Culprit, mode 1 alone, picked on the opponent's face-down Gray Ogre, turns it face up (a 2/2 Ogre again); your face-down Hill Giant stays face down.
